_comment: Season 3 CurseForge pack news (bundled; newsUrl is blank in this pack).

entries.title: No more crashes near contraptions
entries.body: A Create bug could crash your game the moment you came near a contraption with a dropped item, arrow or XP orb caught at just the wrong spot inside it. Everyone in the area got thrown out, and rejoining crashed again. That spot can no longer crash you.

entries.title: Recipe picker and inventory sorting
entries.body: When two recipes share the same ingredients, Polymorph now shows a button so you can pick which one to craft. Create machines also stop fighting over clashing recipes. ClientSort adds one-click sorting to your inventory and chests. Prefer the plain Minecraft menu? Use the Vanilla Menu button in the bottom-right corner of the title screen; it remembers your choice.

entries.title: Replays, 3D inventories and mail rewards
entries.body: A Replay Viewer button now sits beside Mods on the title screen. Spatial GUI (3D inventories) can be switched on and off from the Aero Settings gear. Your /daily rewards, vote rewards and veteran gifts now arrive in your mailbox, and you get a ping whenever new mail lands.

entries.title: Welcome to Season 3
entries.body: A fresh world, a new spawn and a new look. Levels now come from advancements and playtime, claims grow as you level, and your mailbox holds your welcome gift. One mod has to be added by hand: the title screen shows you how.
